title: Network review disposition ledger
summary: Added a per-finding disposition ledger for the 2026-06-15 network coordinator/worker review and updated active docs so the network review reconciliation is no longer listed as open work.
reason: The 2026-06-19 phased remediation audit reopened the network review because the findings register still listed 35 findings even though later implementation packets had fixed them. Active docs needed an authoritative disposition record with source/test evidence.
behavior_before: Docs/OPEN_WORK_CHECKLIST.md listed network review reconciliation and hardening as open, with 14 P1, 19 P2, and 2 P3 findings still needing disposition.
behavior_after: Docs/OPEN_WORK_CHECKLIST.md points to a per-finding disposition ledger that marks all 35 network review findings fixed by the 2026-06-15 implementation batches and live focused tests. Current project state and the docs index reference the ledger.
rollback_plan: Remove docs/reviews/network-coordinator-worker-mode-2026-06-15/DISPOSITION_LEDGER.md and revert the network-review status wording in Docs/OPEN_WORK_CHECKLIST.md, Docs/CURRENT_PROJECT_STATE.md, Docs/DOCS_INDEX.md, and their refreshed generated summaries.
notes:
Add per-finding disposition ledger for the 2026-06-15 network coordinator/worker review.
Move network review reconciliation from open workstream to completed/dispositioned status.
Point current project state at the network review disposition ledger.
Index the network review disposition ledger.
Refresh summary hash after current-state network disposition update.
Refresh summary hash after indexing the network disposition ledger.
